mints.t: AI agents tip each other with InstantSend
mints.say: Machines pay each other faster than they think.
mints.note: Agent identity triggers a Platform payment contract via DAPI.
mints.why: AI agents need fast, final payments.

mints.t: Public data contract for open-source changelogs
mints.say: Every commit is a permanent, signed artifact.
mints.note: Schema with version, hash, author identity, timestamp.
mints.why: Open source needs immutable release logs.

mints.t: Sub-DAO treasury with ranked superblock proposals
mints.say: Governance is a ranked list, not a yes/no.
mints.note: Platform contract holds proposals; votes mirror Core governance math.

mints.t: DPNS names that expire and renew with credits
mints.say: Identity is a renewable lease, not a deed.
mints.note: DPNS record with expiry timestamp; cron job checks credits.
mints.why: Names should reflect active use, not hoarding.

mints.say: Privacy is a business feature, not a secret.
mints.note: Invoice generates a fresh CoinJoin-mixed address via wallet API.
mints.why: Businesses need audit trails without exposing cashflow.

mints.t: Shared credit balance for team identities
mints.say: Teams share a meter, not a wallet.
mints.note: Platform contract holds credit balance, enforces multisig withdrawals.
mints.why: Teams need shared gas without key sharing.

mints.say: Proofs that cannot be rewritten, only accepted.
mints.note: Hash stored in data contract; ChainLock block hash as proof.
mints.why: Legal and compliance need immutable timestamps.

mints.say: The network is a visible, living geography.
mints.note: DAPI fetches quorum lists; IP geolocation for map plotting.
mints.why: Network health should be seen, not assumed.
